input: Research NVIDIA (nvidia.com) for a hedge fund

catalysts.claim: House chairs Mast (Foreign Affairs), Moolenaar (China Select Committee) and Crawford (Intelligence) gave Jensen Huang until Nov 11, 2026 to accept a closed-door briefing set for Nov 18, 2026, or to propose another date. The briefing would cover his contacts with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang and NVIDIA's safeguards against espionage. The request is not a subpoena.

Q3 FY2027 results (quarter ended Oct 25, 2026) come out Tuesday Nov 17, 2026, with the call at 2:00 p.m. PT. Consensus as of Nov 9 is about $108.8B revenue and $2.47 EPS. The company guided $108.0B ±2%.
One aggregator (Chartmill, via search) puts Q3 consensus higher, at about $111.4B revenue and $2.53 EPS. The whisper level is probably above the top of the guidance range.

The board's independent investigation of reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort has no announced end date. The board says it 'will provide further updates as appropriate.' Any update could come at any time.

GTC Washington, D.C. runs Nov 30 to Dec 3, 2026. Huang's keynote is Tuesday Dec 1, 2026 at 2 p.m. ET at the Ronald Reagan Building. It will be his first big public appearance in front of policymakers since the probe began.

Management expects Q4 FY27 (Nov to Jan) to be the low point for gross margin, at 71% to 72%. It says the price increases already put through take effect in FY28. The Q4 print, expected around late Feb 2027 but not confirmed, is the test of that recovery.
The DOJ has asked NVIDIA for information on how its roughly $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition (announced Sept 2026) could affect competitors. No closing timeline has been disclosed.

Incoming Democratic lawmakers say Congress will investigate. Proposals under discussion include congressional oversight of chip export licenses and location-tracking requirements for chips. Democrats won control of Congress in early Nov 2026.

results_vs_guidance.claim: Q2 FY27 (ended Jul 26, 2026) revenue was $96.2B, up 106% year over year and 18% from Q1. That beat the company's $91.0B ±2% guide and the $92.17B LSEG consensus.
The Q2 guide of $91.0B ±2% revenue and 75.0% non-GAAP gross margin was set in the Q1 FY27 release. Q1 revenue was $81.6B.
Q2 non-GAAP EPS was $2.22 against a $2.10 LSEG consensus; GAAP EPS was $2.46. Data Center revenue was $89.0B (+117% y/y) against $86.33B expected (StreetAccount).
Q2 gross margin was 75.0% on both GAAP and non-GAAP bases, in line with the 74.9% GAAP and 75.0% non-GAAP guide.

Current Q3 FY27 guidance: revenue $108.0B ±2%, against $104.2B consensus at the time; gross margin 74.0% ±50bp on both bases; opex about $9.2B GAAP and $9.0B non-GAAP; FY27 tax rate 16% to 18%. The guide assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.

Management guided gross margin to bottom at 71% to 72% in Q4 FY27 and settle at 72% to 73% in FY28. It blamed memory costs, with Kress saying price increases 'exceeded our prior expectations and are headed even higher into next year.' The CFO expects FY28 revenue growth of about 70%, limited by supply.
Vera Rubin production shipments began in August 2026. Management expects Rubin to be about 20% of Data Center revenue in Q3 FY27.
Kress said capex at the top five hyperscalers should rise to $1.3T next year from $800B in 2026.

event_driven.claim: On Nov 8, 2026 the board opened an independent investigation, run by a committee of independent directors with outside counsel, into reports that Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. The board says it has 'no reason to believe' national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised and that it has confidence in Huang.
In an employee memo released Nov 8, Huang admitted infidelity, apologized to shareholders and partners, said he is fully committed to NVIDIA, and said he will cooperate fully with the board's review.

Buybacks: 94M shares for $19.7B in Q2 FY27 and 203M shares for $39.8B in the first half. $99.3B of authorization remained after an $80.0B increase approved May 18, 2026. The quarterly dividend was raised from $0.01 to $0.25.
M&A: the roughly $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition (announced Sept 2026) is under DOJ inquiry. NVIDIA's $20B Groq asset/licensing deal has also drawn DOJ scrutiny.
The FT, via Bloomberg, reported that NVIDIA is in early talks with Reflection AI about options including an acquisition, a bigger stake or compute supply. No terms have been agreed.

NVIDIA gave SB Energy a $105B residual value guarantee for a 9-building AI campus in Portsmouth, Ohio, with OpenAI as tenant. The buildings come online 2028 to 2030, and NVIDIA will sell GPU systems to OpenAI as each phase completes.

credit_signals.claim: S&P upgraded NVIDIA to AA from AA- on Jun 11, 2026 (stable outlook). Moody's rates it Aa1 with a positive outlook after a one-notch upgrade in January 2026.

S&P affirmed the AA rating after the $105B Ohio guarantee. It adds a debt adjustment of $4.2B in 2028, rising to about $37.7B in 2031. S&P would consider a downgrade if adjusted leverage exceeds 1.5x.

NVIDIA priced $25B of senior notes in seven tranches (2028 to 2056) on Jun 15, 2026, at T+35bp for 2031, T+50 for 2036 and T+65 for 2056. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including refinancing.

As of Jul 26, 2026: senior notes outstanding $33.5B principal ($33.366B carrying). The only note due within 12 months was the $1.0B 3.20% note due Sept 2026; whether it has been repaid is not confirmed. The $25.0B commercial paper program was undrawn.

Liquidity as of Jul 26, 2026: cash $22.4B, marketable debt securities $34.1B, marketable equity securities $42.8B and non-marketable securities $51.2B. Supply and capacity commitments rose to $279B from $119B the prior quarter; total commitments are $366B.
Debt due in 1 to 5 years rose to $15B from $2.75B in the prior filing. NVIDIA added indebtedness as a standalone risk factor.

alternative_signals.claim: On Oct 27 to 29, 2026, Oracle and NVIDIA announced that Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs are generally available on OCI, with a plan (no contract value given) to grow OCI Superclusters to multi-gigawatt scale. OpenAI is an early Vera CPU customer.
Korea push on Nov 8 to 9, 2026: a sovereign AI collaboration on NVLink Fusion with Rebellions and SK Telecom, and new planned investments in Korean startups.
Customer concentration rose. At Jul 26, 2026, five direct customers made up 22%, 14%, 13%, 11% and 10% of accounts receivable, up from three customers above 10% in January 2026.

China: about 8% of revenue (including Hong Kong) in the latest quarter. H200 shipments to China were under 1% of Data Center revenue for the quarter ended July 2026. Beijing has not approved large-scale imports despite US licenses for Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance.
Peer rotation: on Nov 9, 2026 NVDA fell 4.27% while AMD rose 13.26%, Broadcom 8.78% and Marvell 9.49%.

insider_and_ownership.claim: Director Mark Stevens sold 622,239 shares at $231.62 (about $144.1M) on Sep 4, 2026, cutting his holding 21% to 2,336,531 shares. EVP Timothy Teter sold 30,460 shares at $222.80 on Sep 21 under a 10b5-1 plan.
Insiders sold 1,766,118 shares worth $399.45M in the last 90 days. Insiders own 3.94% and institutions 65.27%.

Jensen Huang has made no open-market sales in 2026 and his 2025 10b5-1 plan ended Oct 29, 2025. His dispositions were charitable gifts (400,000 shares Jun 16 and 438,000 Sep 17) and tax withholdings. He holds about 811.5M shares per the Sep 18 Form 4. The tracker's data is internally inconsistent.

Q2 2026 13Fs (secondary source): Point72 cut NVDA up to 83.3%, Two Sigma about 42.7% and Citadel about 13.6% (about 18.6M shares). Renaissance added about 180.6%, D.E. Shaw about 19.9% and Millennium about 8.6%.

risks.claim: Key-man and governance risk. Bernstein (Outperform, $400 target) expects the overhang to last and flags that Huang has about 60 direct reports and no clear successor.

Export-control enforcement risk. A Commerce probe of Megaspeed was moved to the DOJ after NVIDIA's general counsel emailed Commerce, per the NYT. Trump said the FBI is looking into it. A May 2026 Culper Research short report claimed China-driven demand was above 20% of FY26 compute revenue.
Margin compression from memory costs: gross margin is guided from 75% to a 71% to 72% Q4 low. Any further rise in memory prices threatens the 72% to 73% FY28 recovery.
Fixed-commitment risk if demand slows: $279B in supply and capacity commitments, a $105B Ohio residual value guarantee and rising receivables concentration.
Litigation: on Mar 25, 2026 a court certified an investor class in In re NVIDIA Corporation Securities Litigation. Derivative suits are stayed and no loss is accrued.
Antitrust risk to the deal strategy: the DOJ is examining both the $12.9B Hugging Face acquisition and the $20B Groq deal.
Technical damage: NVDA opened at $178.67 on Nov 10, near the low end of its $164.27 to $243.37 52-week range and below its 50-day ($219.03) and 200-day ($204.50) moving averages. Beta is 2.21.

output.research_view: Business results are still very strong, but the stock is now trading on the Huang investigation. It has fallen about 27% from its $243.37 high, while Q2 beat guidance by about $5B, Q3 was guided to $108B, and S&P (AA) and Moody's (Aa1) both hold top-tier ratings. Over the next three weeks the key events are whether Huang accepts the Nov 18 House briefing (answer due Nov 11), the Nov 17 print, and the Dec 1 GTC DC keynote. On the call, watch Q3 gross margin against the 73.5% low end of guidance, Rubin's share of revenue, and any comment on the probe or China exports. The tail risk is not demand but a finding that forces a change of leadership or tighter export enforcement. Without that, the setup favors a recovery, with the stock at about 22x trailing earnings against roughly 70% FY28 growth guidance.
missing_fields: Q3 FY27 EPS guidance (NVIDIA does not guide EPS; only the $2.38 LSEG EPS expectation at the time was found)
Exact Q4 FY27 earnings date (not yet announced)
Confirmation that the $1.0B 3.20% Sept 2026 note was repaid
Revolving credit facility size and terms
Names of the board investigation committee members and the outside counsel firm
Expected closing date and status of the Hugging Face acquisition
Start date and status of the DOJ inquiry into the Groq deal (primary source not opened)
Q3 2026 (Sep 30) 13F changes at the largest holders and hedge funds
Any 10b5-1 plan adopted by Huang or other officers after Apr 26, 2026 (Part II Item 5 of the Q2 10-Q not read)
GPU and data-center system price changes (only management comments that price increases were executed)
Hiring and job-posting data from primary sources
Primary text of the Culper Research short report
Status of Poolside and Perplexity deals (secondary reports only)
